content.heading: Stay local by default
content.body: The activity bar shows what sits near the caret — not the whole workspace.

slides.notes: That discipline matters when you later hand context to an LLM.

content.heading: Sync and hop depth
content.body: Sync follows the caret. Hop depth widens how far references travel. Keep it small while learning.

slides.notes: Keep hop depth small while you are learning.

content.heading: Copy a focused slice
content.body: Paste into chat on purpose. Do not dump every .rq file.

slides.notes: Token-minimising context beats dumping the workspace.

content.heading: Try this
content.body: Turn sync off, pin one idea, click around the editor, then turn sync back on.

slides.notes: Ideas Summary is for broader navigation when you choose it.
